name: knit
description: 轻量项目辅助 CLI：项目资料、任务、规范演进、实施／检查、提交归档与恢复。

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-bridge-schema.mjs
scripts.test: npm run -s typecheck && npm run -s build && keys="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/knit-test-keys-XXXXXX")" && trap 'rm -rf "$keys"' EXIT && env -u REX_SESSION -u REX_BLOCK -u REX_SERVER -u REX_BIN_DIR -u TERM_PROGRAM -u TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION -u KNIT_STAGE_RUN_ID KNIT_KEYS_ROOT="$keys" node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
